title: isjiamu/gzh-design-skill
claim: isjiamu/gzh-design-skill — 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeC
why_good: WeChat's editor strips normal HTML/CSS, so every 公众号 author hand-fights formatting; this packages two veteran creators' typesetting rules as an agent skill with all-inline output and deterministic validation — 300 forks in a month says writers actually run it.
value: 商业价值: WeChat content tooling is a proven paid market (秀米/135编辑器 sell templates to millions of creators); the AI-native version charges for theme packs, brand templates for MCN/agency teams, and a hosted Markdown→publish pipeline.
risk: AGPL and a single maintainer, built on undocumented editor quirks WeChat can break in any update; incumbents can bolt AI onto their template stores — a business here needs the hosted pipeline, not a skill file.
hook: Transform Markdown into polished HTML for WeChat with just one click, already racking up 2,607 stars.

zh.claim: 将 Markdown 一键转化为可直接粘贴到公众号编辑器的精致 HTML。
zh.hook: 一键将 Markdown 转换为精美的 WeChat HTML，已获得 2,607 星的关注。
zh.why_good: 公众号编辑器会吞掉常规 HTML/CSS，排版是每个作者的日常痛点；它把两位资深创作者的排版经验打包成 Agent 技能，样式全内联加确定性校验，一个月 300 fork 说明真的有人在用。
zh.value: 商业价值：公众号排版是被验证过的付费市场（秀米/135编辑器靠模板服务数百万创作者）；AI 原生版本可以卖主题包、MCN/机构品牌模板，以及 Markdown 一键发布的托管管线。
zh.risk: AGPL 且单人维护，依赖微信编辑器未文档化的行为，一次改版就可能全破；老牌编辑器也能加上 AI 导出——要成生意得做托管管线，而不是一个技能文件。

pick_reason: It provides a clear product for content creators to monetize by simplifying the publishing process on a popular platform.
